summary: Project to build/deploy a site/app with an admin panel, with a requirement that the personal records database be kept outside/separate from the admin panel.
architectural_notes: Personal records data store must be separated from the admin panel (separate access boundary/storage).

existing_features.title: Update the frontend so the Admin Panel no longer displays or manages the personal records database; instead, implement a separate “Personal Records” experience outside the Admin Panel for signed-in users.
Add/adjust React Query hooks and mutations to support personal-record CRUD outside the Admin Panel, with correct cache keys and optimistic/refresh behavior similar to the existing admin-record flows.

new_feature_requests.summary: Keep the personal records database outside/separate from the admin panel (separate storage/access boundary).

Create a separate backend storage boundary for “personal records” that is not shared with the Admin Panel’s record storage, and expose dedicated APIs for users to manage only their own personal records.

If the backend data schema changes in a way that would otherwise drop or orphan existing stored records, add a conditional Motoko migration to preserve existing data into the appropriate new store(s).

projectName: Separate personal records database from the Admin Panel
